title: Wrap SQLite migrations in transactions
description: Wrap schema migrations and seed operations in a transaction in MemorySmith.Storage/SqliteMemorySmithDatabase.cs. Add retry/backoff for SQLITE_BUSY and add unit/integration tests.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: 2026-08-08 deep-dive reverified migration DDL, seed writes, and migration-record insertion are not wrapped as one transaction or guarded by an inter-process migration lock. WAL/busy_timeout do not provide migration atomicity. Add crash/parallel-startup evidence.
